blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Defending champion EJ Obiena enters the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games with the best mark by an Asian men’s pole vaulter this year and the Asian record. From Jan. 24 through Sept. 1, Obiena competed in 26 meets, winning nine and finishing on the podium 14 times. He set his season best of 5.91 meters at the Golden Sand meet in Poland on Aug. 17. That mark leads the 2026 Asian list by 1 centimeter over Qatar’s Seifeldin Abdelsalam. China’s Li Chenyang is next at 5.86 meters. Both challengers appear on the official Asian Games entry list.
